section.content: 本发明涉及一种半导体集成电路，其包括以推挽方式对负载提供预定电压的电源电路，能够在电源电路工作开始时，防止大电流从输出级的P沟道晶体管流向N沟道晶体管。该半导体集成电路具有以下电路：第一放大电路(10)，其接收第一电位，向输出端供电；第二放大电路(20)，其接收第二电位，从输出端吸收电流；控制电路(30)，其在第一放大电路开始工作之后，控制第二放大电路，以使经过预定的时间后，第二放大电路开始工作。

A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided comprising a first amplifier circuit which receives a first potential and then supplies a current to an output terminal; a second amplifier circuit which receives a second potential and then absorbs a current from the output terminal; and a control circuit which controls the second amplifier circuit so as to allow the second amplifier circuit to be activated subsequently to a predetermined period of time that elapses after the first amplifier circuit is activated.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to the semiconductor integrated circuit of a kind of for example lcd driver etc., it has the voltage follower formula power circuit that load is provided predetermined voltage by push pull mode.

Background technology

In power circuits such as existing lcd driver, the employing that has push-pull circuit as shown in Figure 5.Power circuit shown in Figure 5 comprises: first amplifying circuit 100, use p channel transistor in output stage, from the power supply potential V of high potential one side DDPower to output; Second amplifying circuit 200 adopts the N channel transistor in output stage, by the power supply potential V of electronegative potential one side SSAbsorption is from the electric current of output output.

In these amplifying circuits 100 and 200, import by resistance R 10, R20, R30 the current potential V that electronegative potential one side is predetermined respectively LThe current potential V predetermined with high potential one side HThe first current potential V that is obtained after the dividing potential drop 10With the second current potential V 20The first current potential V to first amplifying circuit, 100 input electronegative potentials 10, to the second current potential V of second amplifying circuit, 200 input high potentials 20So the N channel transistor of the p channel transistor of the output stage of common first amplifying circuit 100 and second amplifying circuit, 200 output stages can not worked simultaneously.

But, when power circuit is started working, because the situation of working simultaneously appears in each several part current potential instability, the output stage p channel transistor of first amplifying circuit 100 and second amplifying circuit, 200 output stage N channel transistors sometimes, at this moment will produce the problem that big electric current passes through.On the other hand, because resistance R 20 numerical value are strengthened, make the first current potential V 10With the second current potential V 20Imbalance increase, just produced the problem of power circuit output voltage such as undulation vibration.

; in 1986-79312 number bulletin of Japanese patent application; disclosed direct current amplifier with imbalance adjusting device; this imbalance adjusting device; be that the flip-flop that will contain in the amplifier output is input to the window comparator, when surpassing to a certain degree, make comparand register work one by one; control signal is sent to multiplexer, with the mid point of control primary amplifier universal source electrode resistance.

In addition, be provided with differential transistor in the semiconductor integrated circuit that in 1995-106875 number bulletin of Japanese patent application, discloses; Be connected to the current source transistor on the source electrode that is connected jointly with differential transistor; With their parallel resistor and current source transistor; And, output is returned to the comparator of two current source transistors with after resistance both end voltage and the reference voltage comparison.

But the technology that discloses in these documents is for the DC that adjusts output potential lacks of proper care, rather than the technology of recommending action in the control output stage.

Summary of the invention

Therefore, in view of above-mentioned technology shortcoming, the objective of the invention is to solve: provide in the semiconductor integrated circuit of power circuit of predetermined voltage to load having with push pull mode, prevent when power circuit work begins, occur from the p channel transistor of output stage to the flow problem of big electric current of N channel transistor.

In order to solve above problem, the semiconductor integrated circuit that the present invention relates to has: first amplifying circuit, and it receives first current potential, and powers to output; Second amplifying circuit, it receives second current potential, and from the output absorption current; Control circuit, it controls second amplifying circuit after first amplifying circuit is started working, so that through behind the preset time, second amplifying circuit is started working.

This semiconductor integrated circuit also possesses the current potential generative circuit, and it can generate first current potential, first and second current potential also higher than second current potential.

Here, first amplifying circuit comprises the p channel transistor of first differential amplifier and output stage, equally also can allow second amplifying circuit comprise the N channel transistor of second differential amplifier and output stage.

In this case, first amplifying circuit also can comprise: according to first control signal, and under first pattern, the transistor that the p channel transistor of output stage is closed; And second amplifying circuit also can comprise: according to second control signal, under first and second pattern, the transistor that the N channel transistor of output stage is closed.

Further, first amplifying circuit can also comprise: according to first control signal, under second and third pattern, to constituting the transistor that differential two the right transistors of first differential amplifier are powered; Equally, second amplifying circuit also can comprise: according to second control signal, under three-mode, to constituting the transistor that differential two the right transistors of second differential amplifier are powered.

In above circuit, control circuit also can pass through counting clock signal, after the first control signal pattern that is provided to first amplifying circuit changes, make the second control signal pattern that is provided to second amplifying circuit, changing through behind the preset time.

If according to the present invention who as above constitutes, so that in the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the power circuit that adopts push pull mode load to be provided predetermined voltage, when providing after first amplifying circuit of electric current starts working to output from p channel transistor, behind the process preset time, the absorption of N channel transistor is started working from second amplifying circuit of the electric current of output output, and then, prevented that when power circuit is started working big electric current flows to the problem generation of N channel transistor from the p channel transistor of output stage.

Fig. 2 is the circuit diagram of the physical circuit example of first and second amplifying circuit shown in Figure 1.

Embodiment

Below with reference to the accompanying drawings, describe around embodiments of the present invention.

Fig. 1 illustrates that an embodiment of the invention relate to is included in power circuit pie graph in the semiconductor integrated circuit.As shown in Figure 1, this power circuit comprises: first amplifying circuit 10, and it uses p channel transistor in output stage, according to the first control signal PS1, powers to output; Second amplifying circuit 20 uses the N channel transistor in output stage, according to the second control signal PS2, from the output absorption current; And control circuit 30, it makes second amplifying circuit 20 start working later at preset time after first amplifying circuit 10 is started working, and according to the first control signal PS1, generates the second control signal PS2.

In these amplifying circuits 10 and 20, import by resistance R 1, R2, R3 the current potential V that electronegative potential one side is predetermined respectively LThe current potential V predetermined with high potential one side HThe first current potential V that is obtained after the dividing potential drop 1With the second current potential V 2The first current potential V to first amplifying circuit, 10 input electronegative potentials 1, to the second current potential V of second amplifying circuit, 20 input high potentials 2When power circuit is started working, because the current potential instability of each element, the situation that probably can cause the N channel transistor both sides of the p channel transistor of first amplifying circuit, 10 output stages and second amplifying circuit, 20 output stages to work simultaneously, but, by activating after first amplifying circuit 10, through behind the preset time, activate second amplifying circuit 20 again, just can prevent that big electric current is by amplifying circuit 10 and 20.

Fig. 2 illustrates the physical circuit example of first and second amplifying circuit.

First amplifying circuit 10 comprises: the differential amplifier that is made of p channel transistor QP1, QP2 and N channel transistor QN3, QN4; The N channel transistor QN5 that is used for this differential amplifier operating current of on/off; The p channel transistor QP6 of output stage; Be used to close the p channel transistor QP7 of output stage transistor; And the capacitor C 1 used of phase compensation.

The first control signal PS1 is when low level, and transistor QN5 closes, and differential amplifier work stops, and simultaneously, after the transistor QP7 conducting, output stage transistor QP6 is closed condition.On the other hand, if during the first control signal PS1 high level, transistor QN5 conducting, and differential amplifier work, simultaneously, transistor QP7 disconnects, output stage transistor QP6 work.

Second amplifying circuit 20 comprises: the differential amplifier that is made of N channel transistor QN1, QN2 and p channel transistor QP3, QP4; The p channel transistor QP5 that is used for this differential amplifier operating current of on/off; The N channel transistor QN6 of output stage; Be used to close the N channel transistor QN7 of output stage transistor; And the capacitor C2 that uses of phase compensation.

The second control signal PS2 is when high level, and transistor QP5 disconnects, and differential amplifier work stops, and transistor QN7 conducting simultaneously makes the transistor QN6 of output stage become closed condition.On the other hand, if during the second control signal PS2 low level, transistor QP5 conducting, differential amplifier work, transistor QN7 disconnects simultaneously, the transistor QN6 work of output stage.

Fig. 3 illustrates the physical circuit example of control circuit.As shown in Figure 3, control circuit 30 comprises 3 triggers 31～33.The first control signal PS1 is offered the reset signal output of trigger 31～33.In energy saver mode, the first control signal PS1 is a low level, and trigger 31～33 is from reversed-phase output output high level signal.

For Control work principle shown in Figure 3 is described, Fig. 4 has provided sequential chart.The first control signal PS1 is a high level, if remove energy saver mode, then is transformed into secure operating mode.In secure operating mode, trigger 31 is exported the first sub-frequency clock signal CK1 after the clock signal C K that imports is carried out two divided-frequency; Trigger 32 is exported the second sub-frequency clock signal CK2 after the first sub-frequency clock signal CK1 is carried out two divided-frequency.In addition, the rising edge of the trigger 33 and the second sub-frequency clock signal CK2 is synchronous, will be adjusted to low level from the second control signal PS2 of reversed-phase output output.Like this, be transformed into normal mode of operation from secure operating mode.

If with reference to Fig. 2～Fig. 4, under energy saver mode, because the first control signal PS1 is a low level, the second control signal PS2 is a high level, so in amplifying circuit 10 and 20, differential amplifier and output stage transistor are not worked.If be transformed into secure operating mode, the first control signal PS1 is a high level so, and the second control signal PS2 still is a high level, and therefore, though first amplifying circuit 10 is started working, second amplifying circuit 20 is not worked.If when being transformed into normal mode of operation, then the first control signal PS1 is a high level, and the second control signal PS2 becomes low level, so amplifying circuit 10 and 20 both sides work.

Like this, when having removed energy saver mode,, can prevent that just short circuit current from flowing to the transistor QN6 of second amplifying circuit, 20 output stages from the transistor QP6 of first amplifying circuit, 10 output stages by the attack time of stagger amplifying circuit 10 and 20.Particularly when the output current potential rises,, the grid of second amplifying circuit, 20 output stage transistor QN6 is applied high potential by phase compensating capacitor C2, but, because only make transistor QN7 conducting within the predetermined time, so, can prevent that super-high-current from passing through output stage transistor QN6.In addition, there is no need to strengthen the first current potential V 1With the second current potential V 2Misalignment rate, therefore, the output voltage that can also solve power circuit produces wavy oscillation problem.

As mentioned above, if employing the present invention, comprise so with push pull mode providing the semiconductor integrated circuit of the power circuit of predetermined voltage, just can prevent when power circuit work begins that big electric current flows to the N channel transistor from the p channel transistor of output stage to load.

Although the present invention is illustrated with reference to accompanying drawing and preferred embodiment,, for a person skilled in the art, the present invention can have various changes and variation.Various change of the present invention, variation and equivalent are contained by the content of appending claims.
